features.quote: beneath the Byzantine building ... a stepped water pool
features.subtype: stepped water pool (Heb. brekhat mayim medoraget) in the earlier layer

date.basis: report compares the type to late Second Temple pools but says the date of the earlier layer cannot yet be determined

notes: One-paragraph report, no plan. The pool lies beneath the Byzantine monastery; no direction within the site is given, so position none. Date left U: the report links the type to the end of the Second Temple period but explicitly says the earlier layer is not yet dated. The moat at the western end of the site is a ditch, not a pool or pit, and is not coded. No burials mentioned (silence, not absence). E360 is the unit's own excavation row at the same point, not a separate site, so no grid position.
